Conclusion
Remembering basic concepts for acid-base balance will keep 
you on track in evaluating these complex clinical situations.

Th e scale for measuring acidity or alkalinity of a ﬂ uid is the
measurement of pH. Simply stated, pH is the ratio of bases 
to acids. Normal pH in humans is 7.35–7.45. Th e pH is
maintained in a ratio of 20:1 base to acid within body ﬂ uids.
